scenes.text: Two thousand and forty-eight dollars, to prove anyone can run their own Farcaster. No API keys. No permission.
Hetzner said no. AWS said no. Azure was sold out, size after size, until one wasn't.
Eleven hours later, my node had downloaded half a terabyte of Farcaster.
Except one shard. Five hundred and seventy days behind.
Its snapshot had vanished mid-download. So I wrote a fix, and sent it to the Snapchain team.
An hour later, every shard was in sync.
Then I typed my seed phrase, once. The client made its own key. No gas. No wallet transaction.
And I posted. From my own node.
Three commands. Your own Farcaster. Link's below. Your turn.
